title: [Email - Outlook REST API] Skip attachments without contentBytes in RetrieveEmails
summary: The Email - Outlook REST API connector now skips attachments without contentBytes instead of failing the entire batch, allowing emails with non-file attachments to be imported successfully.
key_points: Attachments without contentBytes (item and reference attachments) are now skipped instead of failing the batch
File attachments with contentBytes are handled as before
A single email with a non-file attachment, such as a bounce notification, no longer rolls back every email imported in the run
Regression test and payload added for non-file attachments
